Welcome to C-Store Dive's Daily Dive!

From here on out, we'll keep you up-to-speed with the latest news and trends shaping the convenience store industry.

What you can expect from the Daily Dive:

     

  • Daily, digestible news stories: Monday through Friday, our team of independent journalists will deliver a neatly packaged newsletter to your inbox with original stories and deep analysis. With your busy schedule in mind, most articles are written in a “brief” format to help you understand the key takeaways and broader industry impact. Get reading.

    •  

  • Original content, free of charge: To provide you with exclusive stories and deep industry reporting at no cost, you may also receive email messages from our supporting sponsors throughout the week. We strive to make them relevant to you and your broader industry and our sponsors have zero influence on our editorial content.

    •  

  • Bonus weekend round up: As part of your subscription, you’ll receive our complimentary Weekender edition every Saturday, highlighting the most-read stories from the week. You may adjust your subscription at any time.

Important information about your newsletter subscription:

     

  • Add us to your inbox: To ensure we make it into your inbox regularly, add us to your allow list, mark us as a safe sender, add us to your address book (newsletter@divenewsletter.com), or simply respond to this email (this helps signal you want to hear from us!). If you are a Gmail user, click on this email and drag it to your Primary Inbox tab. For more information, here are some instructions.

    •  

  • Change your mind? If after receiving the newsletter, you decide it is not for you, you can unsubscribe at any time.

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us at any time.

Thanks for reading. We hope you enjoy the Daily Dive newsletter. We’re so glad you’re here!

 

 Best,

 Jeff Wells

 Lead Editor, C-Store Dive
